content:
maya_ml: Overnight nightly eval flagged a sudden regression on the Llama-4b INT8 precision profile. Summarization ROUGE-L down ~6% for the core prompt set, and a cluster of samples show very high stop-token probs mid-generation.

vik_engineer: saw the alert. link: https://internal/redwood/evals/2182... eval-bot tagged 83 samples as failures :rotating_light:

luca_research: FP8 profile on the same model looks stable in the same run. this smells like a calibration / zero-point shift in the int8 path.

maya_ml: minimal repro: compare token probs for sample 482. before (baseline quant) vs after (nightly INT8):
```
# baseline (float): step12 token_probs: {"20": 0.0009, "21": 0.0003, "stop": 0.0007}
# nightly INT8: step12 token_probs: {"20": 0.02, "21": 0.01, "stop": 0.45}
```

sam_ops: any infra changes overnight? deploy-bot: rolled model-serving image redwood/serve:1.12.0 at 2182342000 (canary-first, then roll). also autoscaler updated to consider queue-size metric.

vik_engineer: I pulled the nightly artifact and ran local eval with --quant-profile=int8-calib-v2. Reproduced stop-prob jump on ~60/83 samples. Turning off per-channel scales (force per-tensor) makes behavior go back to baseline on many samples.

luca_research: interesting — per-channel scale interaction with layernorms can amplify bias if zero_point not properly centered. did calibration use MSE or KL? maya_ml: we used KL with 512 calibration samples from reprset-2026-03-19.

vik_engineer: quick diff between calib runs: mean scale shift +0.07 on final layers, and mean zero_offset moved -0.11. KL loss on calib improved but downstream token distributions changed.

maya_ml: action items: 1) vik to run ablation toggling per-channel vs per-tensor and zero_offset removal (ETA 2h). 2) luca to audit calibration code path for rounding logic and confirm whether we changed histogram bucket boundaries in 1.12.0 (ETA EOD). 3) sam to pin serving image to prev version for canary if we see production regressions.

vik_engineer: repro command I'm using:
```
python tools/run_eval.py --model=llama-4b --artifact=artifacts/218234 --quant-profile=int8-calib-v2 --prompt-set=summarize-core --samples=500
```

maya_ml: tagged @vik_engineer and added failing sample list to the bug: https://issues/redwood/ML-4671. I'll run pairwise diff (int8-calib-v1 vs v2) across the reprset and upload CSV.

eval-bot: nightly-eval finished: 83 failures (↑71 vs previous). breakdown attached.

sam_ops: I'll stand by to rollback canary if we see rate of failures in dedicated pods. :thumbsup:

maya_ml: thanks — please post quick notes in the ticket and ping if you need more repro logs.
